# Health HIVE

Health HIVE is an Irish digital health platform for the safe, auditable digitisation of patient files in primary and secondary care. It connects patients, caregivers, practitioners, and first responders through secure digital tools — patient-held records, streamlined clinical documentation and GDPR-first data protection (GDPR and the Irish Data Protection Act 2018), designed in step with Ireland's Digital for Care 2024–2030 framework, the Sláintecare direction, and HIQA's information-management standards. Alignment reflects design goals, not endorsement or certification by any public body. Based in Dublin, Ireland (IbnCeena Ltd).

## Public pages

- /: Main marketing landing page — overview of the Health HIVE platform and its services
- /book: Book a consultation or appointment with a Health HIVE practitioner
- /portal: Patient and practitioner portal landing page
- /portal/login: Sign in to the Health HIVE portal
- /portal/signup: Create a new Health HIVE portal account
- /portal/pricing: Membership tiers and pricing plans (Blue, Gold, Red)
- /portal/privacy: Privacy policy and data handling information
